name: Video player
summary: A themed wrapper around the native video element with captions, keyboard shortcuts and a visible focus order. Never autoplay with sound.

anatomy.purpose: The native <video> with controls disabled in favour of themed buttons, or native controls as fallback.
A <track kind="captions"> for prerecorded speech; required for any spoken content.
Play/pause, seek, time display, captions toggle, fullscreen; every control keyboard reachable.
Link to a full text transcript next to the player for long-form content.

variants.name: Inline
variants.use: Embedded in an article or lesson body.

variants.name: Hero
variants.use: Large player at the top of a page; still never autoplays with sound.

whenToUse: The content is inherently motion/audio (demo, lesson, talk).
Captions can be provided for all speech.
whenNotToUse: The content is short text or static images: use a figure instead.
You cannot caption the audio: do not publish the video.

accessibility.role: application (or native video with controls); captions via track element
keyboard: Tab reaches play/pause, seek, captions toggle and fullscreen in visual order.
Space or K toggles play/pause; arrow Left/Right seek 5 seconds; F toggles fullscreen; C toggles captions.
accessibility.focus: Every control shows a 2px focus-visible ring with at least 3:1 contrast against the scrim behind the controls.
notes: Captions are mandatory for prerecorded speech (WCAG 1.2.2); provide transcripts for audio-only content.
Do not autoplay with sound (WCAG 1.4.2); if autoplay is used, it must be muted and pausable.
Never rely on color alone for the captions-on indicator.
